import ast,subprocess,sys,os,tempfile,json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(sys.argv[1]); tree=ast.parse(p.read_text()); fn=next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='run')
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='tdf-header-driver-control-') as td:
 scope={'subprocess':subprocess,'root':Path(td),'out':Path(td),'env':os.environ.copy(),'report':{'steps':[]},'save':lambda:None}
 exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[fn],type_ignores=[]),str(p),'exec'),scope)
 run=scope['run']; checked=[]
 for label,cmd,expected,mustFail in [('zero',[sys.executable,'-c','pass'],None,False),('nonzero',[sys.executable,'-c','raise SystemExit(7)'],None,True),('wrong-marker',[sys.executable,'-c','raise SystemExit(7)'],'required marker',True),('named-rejection',[sys.executable,'-c','import sys; print("required marker",file=sys.stderr);sys.exit(1)'],'required marker',False)]:
  failed=False
  try:run(label,cmd,expected=expected)
  except AssertionError:failed=True
  if failed!=mustFail:raise RuntimeError('Harness failed control '+label)
  checked.append(label)
 print(json.dumps({'optimization':sys.flags.optimize,'controls':checked,'passed':True}))
